targetText: With what remarkable ease do our “positivists” and “realists” turn out “universal laws”! What a pity these laws are no whit better than those turned out as easily and swiftly by Eugen Dühring. Suvorov’s “universal law” is just as empty and bombastic a phrase as Dühring’s universal laws.
explanation: Lenin exposes the bankrupt method of the revisionists, who substitute superficial biological and energetic analogies for concrete historical materialist analysis of class relations.
